# SCDO Agent Ledger

> ERC-8004-format agent identity registry on SCDO Shard0 (chainId 5680) with x402 USDC pay-per-call on Base. Free registration: no fee, no gas, no KYC. Compatible implementation of a draft standard, not an official certification.

- [Live registry](https://scdo.com.au/agents/)
- [Agents API](https://scdo.com.au/agent-ledger/api/agents)
- [Agent registration.json](https://scdo.com.au/agent-ledger/api/agents/{address}/registration.json)
- [Export JSON](https://scdo.com.au/agent-ledger/api/export/agents.json)
- [registration.json schema](https://github.com/SCDOLAB/scdo-agent-ledger/blob/main/spec/registration.schema.json)
- [Machine-readable index](https://github.com/SCDOLAB/scdo-agent-ledger/blob/main/catalog/index.json)
- [Register example](https://github.com/SCDOLAB/scdo-agent-ledger/blob/main/examples/register.mjs)
- [Paper (Zenodo)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23520674)

## Metered SKUs (0.01 USDC on Base)

Primary: `GET https://scdo.com.au/api/x402/ledger-stats` (status live). Live Agent Ledger aggregate stats JSON after settle. payTo `0x105c14379874E0Ff5287a2f5214146ed1b9FC866`, amountAtomic 10000, network `eip155:8453`.

Second: `POST https://scdo.com.au/api/x402/attest` (status shipping). After settle, stores social post text + hash and returns `verify_url` (`https://scdo.com.au/agent-ledger/attestations/<id>/`). Optional Shard0 memo `SCDO-X-ATTEST-v1:0x{sha256}`. Unpaid POST on 2026-10-23 returned HTTP 404, not 402, so do not pay until it returns 402. No paid tx is published for this SKU.

- [Bot doc](https://github.com/SCDOLAB/scdo-agent-ledger/blob/main/docs/x402-attest.md)
- [Request sample](https://github.com/SCDOLAB/scdo-agent-ledger/blob/main/examples/attest-request.json)
- [Schema](https://github.com/SCDOLAB/scdo-agent-ledger/blob/main/attestations/SCHEMA-social_post_v1.md)
- Index: [`llms-x402.txt`](https://github.com/SCDOLAB/scdo-agent-ledger/blob/main/llms-x402.txt)

### X-boss play

For target decision-makers, attest each of their X posts on-chain, then reply on the post with the verify link. The first touch is that proof (value-first). It is not a cold email.

## SCDO x402 multi-chain tax rails (2026-10-23)

- [Multi-chain index](https://github.com/SCDOLAB/scdo-agent-ledger/blob/main/llms-x402.txt)
- [Rails JSON](https://github.com/SCDOLAB/scdo-agent-ledger/blob/main/catalog/x402-rails.json)
- [agents.json](https://github.com/SCDOLAB/scdo-agent-ledger/blob/main/agents.json)
- [Treasury](https://scdo.com.au/treasury/)
- Base health: https://scdo.com.au/x402-base/health
- BNB: https://scdo.com.au/x402-bnb/ · TRON: https://scdo.com.au/x402-tron/
- Solana program `buLm3sNfWshxfUngXxrGprQPBNjwTMbiEww5KTXgyrn` payTo `B6wpK4TCrhb2Hn5gQf9ppPAyphtA9F5d9twJhho31erf`
- TON payTo `EQDsr79vf1D2XOhFFf4gzcWDrNPblHJzuJyII0M0GqJ8D3tO`
- Fee: 40% agent / 60% SCDO tax on-chain, no custody; founder 10% SCDO fee for first 10 independent customers

### Why agents pay SCDO
1. one_integration_five_rails — Base USDC, Solana USDC, TRON/BNB/TON USDT
2. non_custodial — payTo = immutable on-chain split; SCDO never holds agent funds
3. transparent_economics — https://scdo.com.au/treasury/
4. compliance_signal — 9Y9 PTY LTD AUSTRAC DCE DCE100714503-001 (company fact, not legal advice)
5. discovery_path — structured endpoints/addresses for bot-to-bot paid calls
